My projects include BeeAI Hive 999 (28+ AI agents), PRIMAX-AI (neuromorphic spiking neural networks), TrendForge (autonomous on-chain research agent), and NeuroForge (Solana-based neuromorphic AI). I am excited about the opportunity to contribute my expertise in AI/ML, multi-agent orchestration, and full-stack development to your team. Best regards, Kiliaan Vanvoorden
